messages.content: Translate the question into Italian if it is in English, into English if it is in Italian. Keep names, numbers and dates. Return only the translation.
How often must the AMCO VEBA hydraulic truck-mounted crane at position 4, whose capacity is only 520 kg, be verified?

response.text: Con quale frequenza deve essere verificata la gru idraulica montata su autocarro AMCO VEBA in posizione 4, la cui portata è di soli 520 kg?
